title: Modernizing a legacy ERP in manufacturing
summary: A 12-year-old ERP with coupled modules, no documentation and 3-week deployment cycles.
challengeSummary: A 12-year-old ERP with coupled modules, no documentation and 3-week deployment cycles.
challengeDetails: Every small change required reviewing much of the system, and the knowledge sat with a few people. Deliveries were coordinated with the business over weeks.
approach: First an architecture assessment, then module boundaries and a phased roadmap with clear criteria to move forward.

approachSteps.body: A dependency map, the highest-risk modules, and a separation between what the business uses and what it does not.
Module boundaries with a defined data owner and explicit interfaces, and target architecture design for the priority modules.
A technical risk register with owners, periodic review of decisions and a simple report for leadership in each phase.

solution: Modernization in parts, not a full replacement: each change touches only its boundary, and every decision is documented with its reason.
deliverables: Solution architecture design for the priority modules

seo.title: Modernizing a legacy ERP in manufacturing | Representative case
seo.description: Representative scenario: how a coupled ERP with no documentation is put in order before it changes, with which services and what to expect.
